title: Dual-arm object handover
summary: Coordinating two Franka Panda arms through pick, handover and place in Drake.
overview: Two simulated manipulators move a cube between platforms through an intermediate handover. The challenge is coordinating motion within a shared workspace.
constraints: The handover pose must be reachable by both arms. Motion and object-transfer sequencing must be coordinated.
contribution: This is a group project. The implementation includes workspace analysis, inverse kinematics, trajectory generation and handover coordination.
approach: The repository includes an OMPL RRT-Connect planner and a task state machine. The inspected version uses timed transitions and a kinematic attachment for the cube.
results: The simulation implementation is available in the maho_matpao branch. The project is presented as a simulation study, without a claim of physical deployment.
limits: Kinematic attachment does not test contact-based grasp failures. The code also depends on scene assets and a generated handover configuration; timing and placement metrics require the final run records.
